l: (1) "Governmental unit" has the meaning assigned by Section 101.001.
(2) "Religious organization" means an organization that qualifies as a religious organization under Section 11.20, Tax Code.
(3) "Religious worship" has the meaning assigned by Section 11.20, Tax Code.

items.t: SERMONS PRIVILEGED FROM DISCLOSURE TO GOVERNMENTAL UNIT
l: A governmental unit may not, in any civil action or other civil or administrative proceeding to which the governmental unit is a party, compel the production or disclosure of a written copy or audio or video recording of a sermon delivered by a religious leader during religious worship of a religious organization or compel the religious leader to testify regarding the sermon.
